name: Bicycle Crossing
spec: yellow diamond with a black bicycle symbol
meaning: Bicycles may be crossing or sharing the road ahead.

snippets.back: One bicycle sign states that a three foot minimum clearance is required when passing a cyclist.
Rectangular rapid-flashing beacons at pedestrian or bicycle crossings are activated by a pedestrian’s or cyclist’s push button.
Yellow-green warnings can identify pedestrian and bicycle crossings, playgrounds, school-bus stops and school zones.
A bicyclist held at a red bicycle signal that will not change may proceed after stopping completely for at least two minutes and using due caution.
Bicycle signals use red, yellow and green bicycle symbols, allowing bicycle movement on green while motor traffic is stopped.
Fluorescent yellow-green is the color for school, pedestrian and bicycle signs.
The bicycle warning calls for extra attention to bicycles or a bicycle crossing.
On warning signs, yellow warns, yellow-green warns and controls at pedestrian and bicycle crossings and school areas, and orange warns and controls in construction zones.

result.correction: Fluorescent yellow-green is the color for school, pedestrian and bicycle signs; yellow-green warnings can identify pedestrian and bicycle crossings.
result.summary: Meaning supported by bicycle warning calling for extra attention to bicycles or crossing; spec contradicted because official text states bicycle signs/crossings are fluorescent yellow-green, not yellow.
